name: HNF1 homeobox A

function.text: HNF1A encodes hepatocyte nuclear factor 1-alpha. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to monogenic diabetes (autosomal dominant); type 1 diabetes mellitus 20 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Hepatocellular Carcinoma; Papillary Renal Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
